reference.description: Private user-supplied engineering handoff; used only for reader comparison and not archived publicly.

method: One fresh authoring context with inherited model settings and no parent history received the new skill and the same synthetic four-case packet as 0.10.0. The private reference was withheld from the author and shown to a separate fresh reader. No live library, implementation, web, external writes or nested agents. Prior 0.10.0 output is a historical comparison artifact, not a fresh repeated baseline.
normalization: Only scratch paths and request pointers are replaced by placeholders or repository-relative pointers; generated prose is otherwise unchanged.
reader_method: Separate fresh context, no parent history or authoring instructions; same private reference and synthetic request, randomized labels A/B. Labels do not assure blinding because style and artifacts can reveal the method. Readability judgments are task-specific.
review_revision: One author follow-up corrected the reader-confirmed freshness gap, distinguished historical/current source evidence and added a continuous example. The instruction snapshot and five initial artifacts are unchanged. A targeted reader follow-up checks the correction. No superiority claim compares the reviewed result with an unreviewed historical artifact.
checks: Frontmatter parsed with Ruby YAML; required fields present.
Plugin JSON and version entries agree.
Frozen instruction hashes match the evaluated files.
Original supplied plan/draft text retained in controls.
Five initial outputs remain byte-for-byte unchanged after review.
Archived/raw hashes and normalized references checked.
Public-artifact privacy, Markdown fences, relative links and whitespace checked.
